hero.eyebrow: Data & AI strategy · Senior BI Developer · Minneapolis–Saint Paul
hero.pre: I turn data into decisions for leadership, with
hero.body: 10+ years of enterprise reporting in healthcare, manufacturing and supply chain. I help leadership turn data into decisions and bring AI into the data lifecycle: strategy, trusted models, governed reporting and working AI tools.

expertise.title: Data and AI strategy, end to end

items.title: Enterprise data lifecycle
items.body: From source systems to the executive dashboard: I took over and built the SQL Server gold layer for five source systems, including NetSuite, Salesforce, FileMaker and Brightree, and built the pipeline that brings third-party vendor data into the warehouse.

items.title: Data strategy
items.body: I represent BI in analytics strategy discussions with business and IT leadership, and lead development of 12+ semantic models serving four business units, with KPIs defined alongside data stewards.

items.title: AI tools and platforms
items.body: Microsoft Copilot agents grounded in team SharePoint content, built on my own initiative and now used by my team and one other business unit, plus working tools I direct Claude Code to build from written specs and tests.

items.title: Analytics and executive reporting
items.body: Director to C-suite dashboards, including a real-time order operations display, month-end sales forecasts and automated nightly PDF distribution, plus Power BI, Tableau and Sigma self-service analytics.

items.title: Governance and compliance
items.body: Moving reporting onto semantic models whose definitions and calculations are owned by business unit data stewards, and regulatory compliance reporting built from the ground up for a health plan: Commercial MLR, Medicare Advantage, Part D and Medicaid Managed Care.

items.title: Data as competitive advantage
items.body: At Tactile Medical I audited 600+ Power BI reports, retired more than 70% and am moving the rest onto single semantic models so leaders work from one trusted set of figures. At Caterpillar I rebuilt 48+ KPIs to corporate standard formulas so plant decisions rested on validated numbers.

about.title: Experience and skills
about.bio: Over a decade building enterprise reporting in healthcare, manufacturing and supply chain, after an earlier career in operations and process engineering. At Tactile Medical I audited 600+ Power BI reports, retired more than 70% of them, and planned the move of the rest to Fabric semantic models.
